title: Step-by-Step Guide: How to Start Budgeting
content: Starting a budget involves 5 core steps: 1. Calculate net monthly income from all sources. 2. Track all fixed and variable expenses over the past 1-3 months. 3. Categorize expenses into needs (rent, groceries, utilities), wants (dining out, entertainment), and financial goals (savings, investments, debt payment). 4. Apply a realistic framework like 50/30/20. 5. Review monthly spending against targets and adjust as income or life priorities change.
